 short by Ankush Verma / 09:57 am on Tuesday, 17 November 2026 A bus full of female models was seen arriving at Hollywood star Leonardo DiCaprio's home in Los Angeles for his birthday celebrations, with a video surfacing online. DiCaprio also hosted Tobey Maguire, Al Pacino, Noor Alfallah, Jonah Hill, Ice Spice, Stassie Karanikolaou and 50 Cent. 'The Wolf of Wall Street' star's girlfriend, Vittoria Ceretti, 28, was also present. read more at RT Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
